meta.name: ai-content-writer
meta.description: 文案诊断助手适合内容创作者、市场营销、运营、内容媒体在用户提出“这段文案能打动人吗”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成内容诊断、优化建议、执行清单。

copy.tagline: 诊断文案问题并给出优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常写文案但不确定效果如何
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose copy issues and provide optimization suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often write copy but are unsure of its effectiveness

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成文案诊断助手。当你提供文案或内容目标，它会分析文案能否打动人，并给出诊断、优化建议和执行清单。
howto.when: 当你问“这段文案能打动人吗”或需要内容诊断、优化建议时触发。适合内容创作者、营销、运营等角色使用。

say.text: 帮我诊断这段文案，目标受众是年轻白领。
say.note: Claude 会分析文案并给出优化建议。

say.text: 分析这篇产品介绍，目标是提升转化率。
say.note: Claude 会输出诊断和执行清单。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a copywriting diagnosis assistant. When you provide copy or content goals, it analyzes whether the copy is compelling and outputs diagnosis, optimization suggestions, and an action checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask 'Is this copy compelling?' or need content diagnosis and optimization suggestions. Suitable for content creators, marketers, and operators.

say_en.text: Diagnose this copy, target audience is young professionals.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze and give optimization suggestions.

say_en.text: Analyze this product intro, goal is to increase conversion rate.
say_en.note: Claude will output diagnosis and action checklist.
